title: Case Study: How AI Search Engines (Perplexity/ChatGPT) Scrape Luxury Hotel Websites and Why 80% of 5-Star Properties Are Invisible.
summary: Hey everyone, I recently audited 50+ luxury 4-star and 5-star hotel properties across global markets to analyze how generative AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity) handle direct booking recommendations. ​The Problem: When travelers ask AI tools for "the best luxury resorts in [City] with private villas," traditional websites fail to show up. Instead, AI defaults to OTAs like Booking.com , costing hotels 15–20% in commissions. ​Key Findings from the Audit: ​Missing Schema Entities: Over 80% of properties lack proper HotelResort and Offer structured data tailored for LLMs. ​Unstructured Metadata: AI models prioritize semantic context over keyword density. ​The Solution: Implementing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AEO schema directly redirects high-intent travelers to direct booking engines. ​I've compiled the full technical checklist and insights on how properties can fix their AI search visibility. ​Happy to share the breakdown or answer any technical questions in the comments!   submitted by   /u/Training_Ganache_652 [link]   [comments]
